# `morphir package registry init`

- **Usage:** `morphir package registry init <FLAGS>`

Initialize absent publisher state from a caller-signed root and policy

## Flags
- **`--policy <FILE>`** — Trust policy pinning the caller-signed bootstrap root and publisher keys
- **`--root <FILE>`** — Caller-signed bootstrap TUF root envelope
- **`--registry <DIR>`** — New local registry directory
- **`--publisher-state <DIR>`** — New private publisher-state directory
- **`--json`**
